services.name: Solar panel installation
services.blurb: Panels laid out around your trees and vents, flashed into the rafters, wired and inspected.

services.name: Roof assessment
services.blurb: Age, decking, rafters, shade and the electrical panel checked before we talk about panels.

services.name: Battery storage
services.blurb: A battery sized to what you want running in an outage, with a backup panel if needed.

services.name: Inverter service
services.blurb: Error lights, dead screens and tripped breakers traced and fixed, or the inverter replaced.

services.name: Monitoring setup
services.blurb: Your system app reconnected and checked, so you can see what each day produced.

services.name: Panel cleaning
services.blurb: Pollen, smoke ash and bird mess rinsed off with soft brushes and pure water.

services.name: Critter guard
services.blurb: Mesh around the array edge so pigeons and squirrels stop nesting under your panels.

services.name: Detach and reset for re-roofs
services.blurb: Panels taken down, stored and put back with new flashing when your roof is replaced.

services.name: Second opinions
services.blurb: Bring a quote from another company and we walk the roof and read it with you.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Two companies sent me a layout from a satellite photo. Tom climbed on the roof, found soft decking near the chimney and told me to fix that first. That is why we hired them.
reviews.name: Linda G.

reviews.text: Our street is all oaks. They walked the yard with a shade tool, moved the array to the back face and showed us the morning and afternoon shade on paper before the install.
reviews.name: Jason R.

reviews.text: We needed a new roof and had panels from 2014. They took them down, stored them and put them back with new flashing. The roofer said the attachments were the cleanest he had seen.
reviews.name: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Pigeons had moved in under the panels and the noise was constant. They cleaned it out and put mesh around the whole array. Quiet for a full year now.
reviews.name: Hector A.

reviews.text: The inverter screen had a red light for weeks and the original installer had closed. Rafter Line found a ground fault in one string, fixed the wire and it has run fine since.
reviews.name: Paula N.

reviews.text: A door to door seller left us a thick packet. We asked Rafter Line to read it. They explained each page and pointed out two items to ask about. No pressure to sign with them.
reviews.name: Dave W.

proof.guarantee: If a roof attachment we installed ever leaks within 10 years, we fix the roof and the attachment.
